items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially inactive for MNF vs Giants with hip/groin injury after missing Fri/Sat practices; unrelated to prior psoas issue.
items.why: Missed final two practices; trending wrong way pregame.
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated target share; depth WRs/TEs more involved.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Adams and Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: MRI/tests confirmed MCL sprain after exiting early.
items.implication: TE depth thin (Mundt/Jenkins); Ertz reunion; Wicks etc. may see more targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE/WR usage behind DeVonta Smith while Goedert out.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow, same as last year) had imaging; consulting specialists next days. Out Week 3 vs SEA; Marcus Mariota expected to start. No fracture on initial X-rays.
items.why: Second dislocation; protocol for specialists after imaging.
items.implication: Mariota starts; limited timeline clarity beyond W3.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; WAS skill players may see scheme changes.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; will rehab rather than surgery, out several weeks (possible midseason return). Likely heads to IR; surgery still possible.
items.implication: IND WR depth/targets redistribute for weeks.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for other Colts pass-catchers.

items.text: Chargers placing TEs David Njoku (fibula/knee) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) on injured reserve.
items.implication: TE vacuum; Orande Gadsden already saw elevated snaps/routes.
items.opportunity: Gadsden 29/67 snaps, 15 routes on 31 dropbacks in their absence.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12 Sunday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving lead back; Gainwell clear secondary.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) had/will have MRI; hope/minor, played through after returning with neck roll. Limited snaps (12) and production.
items.why: Stinger on first play; returned but limited; cautious MRI.
items.implication: Likely available W3 if minor; monitor practice. Bigsby saw work.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) on extended Sunday injury watchlist; week-to-week per reports, not expected to practice early week, Bagent next up.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring; carted but walked later; imaging.
items.implication: Bagent likely starts vs PHI; CHI offense changes.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and adjusted skill usage.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: McConkey GTD with optimism (later ACTIVE, flak jacket); Nacua GTD (later INACTIVE); Harvey not expected (inactive); Olave/Burrow expected; Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Lineup locks/pivots; Coleman stash for Harvey.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups when OUT.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating treatment and recovery timeframe.
items.implication: GB WR depth/roles TBD; monitor for multi-week.
items.opportunity: Potential snaps for other Packers WRs.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Both can be true.
items.why: Fumble punishment + weapon need with Brown IR/out.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion even if Stevenson starts.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a few WRs worse (incl. Quentin Johnston at 0.48 YPRR, inconceivably horrific).
